page.title: Read the waterline
page.body: Moonlight shows fresh water lapping over the copper-post walkway. The blue-plank boardwalk stands above the wet reeds. Your earlier discovery marks a sheltered way across.

choices.label: Ask Barkley
choices.description: Weave a floating reed mat; no HP cost, a small teamwork bonus.

choices.label: Ask Gloop
choices.description: Weave a floating reed mat; no HP cost, a small teamwork bonus.

choices.label: Take the blue boardwalk
choices.description: Sheltered route: no HP cost; keeps your saved bundle.

choices.label: Take the copper walkway
choices.description: Short route: up to 3% max HP cost; adds 5% to your one bundle.

choices.label: Head home now
choices.description: Bank the earned fraction of your one reward bundle.

page.footer: 2/3 stops · one material bundle · one possible catch · bonus 0%

page.title: Turn the sun mirror
page.body: The old plaque reads: ‘Follow the shade.’ The mirror's crescent mark casts a cool shadow through the dunes; the star mark lights a short, hot ridge. Your earlier discovery marks a sheltered way across.

page.body: The windsock and blowing snow show gusts arriving from the east. The cairn's sketch marks the opposite side as sheltered: the west ledge. The exposed span is shorter. Your earlier discovery marks a sheltered way across.

page.body: A memory bell repeats your first choice: a ringing bell. The branch bearing that sign holds steady. The other is a shorter ribbon of shifting starlight. Your earlier discovery marks a sheltered way across.
